name: payments-api

dependencies.name: mobile-money-service
dependencies.description: Charges a payer's mobile-money wallet for a payment request.

dependencies.name: card-payment-service
dependencies.description: Charges a payer's card for a payment request.

dependencies.name: payout-service
dependencies.description: Disburses a merchant's on-demand payout to their bank account or mobile wallet.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends payer receipts and merchant payout notifications.

description: Backend API for the merchant payments platform: merchant accounts and profiles, payment requests, transaction collection via mobile money and card, refunds, balances, and on-demand payouts. Also exposes platform-admin views over merchants, transactions and payouts. Does not host any UI and does not run scheduled settlement — every payout is triggered by an explicit merchant request.
